setupWizard.title: Installation
setupWizard.alreadyDone: The installation is finished. The till is ready.

start.title: Welcome to Atlas POS
start.lead: Set up this till in a few minutes. What would you like to do?
start.newText: Set up this till step by step.
start.profileText: Reuse the settings of another till (.atlasprofile file).
start.restoreText: Bring a till back from a backup.
start.restoreTitle: Choose the backup folder or drive
start.noBackups: No backup found in this folder.
start.restoreConfirm: The till will be put back in the state of the backup of {{date}}.

language.title: Language
language.lead: Choose the languages of the setup, the receipts and the staff.
language.setupHint: The language of this till's screens.
language.receiptHint: The language printed on receipts and kitchen tickets.
language.staffHint: Each employee can change theirs later.

business.title: What type of business?
business.lead: This choice prepares the modules and the sample catalogue.
business.catalogHint: You can change it later in the back office.
business.sourceImportText: An .xlsx or .csv file of your products.
business.sourceEmptyText: I will enter my products later.
business.importBlocked: The file has errors: fix it and choose it again.

company.title: Company details
company.lead: Only the trade name is required. The legal details (company name, ICE, IF, RC, patente…) are optional: the ones you fill in will appear on your receipts.
company.fromProfile: These details come from the imported profile. Check them: they are the other company's until you confirm them with Next.
company.logoHint: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, 2 MB at most.
company.vatHint: The rates offered at the till. The catalogue may only use these rates.
company.header: Message at the top of the receipt
company.footer: Message at the bottom of the receipt

hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.lead: Connect and test the printers. Nothing is required: you can come back to it.
hardware.virtualHint: Writes receipts to a file instead of printing them: handy to try things without hardware.
hardware.name: Name
hardware.raster: Image mode (if accents do not print)
hardware.nothingDetected: Nothing detected. Add a network or virtual printer.
hardware.routingHint: Choose where each category prints. With no choice, the template decides from the printers' roles.
hardware.routingNone: Add a printer to route categories.
hardware.scannerHint: Scan a code: it should be typed here, then Enter.

users.title: Users
users.lead: The manager, the staff and the technician code.
users.managerHint: Profile: {{profile}}. The PIN is for the till, the username and password for the back office.
users.name: Display name
users.staffHint: Cashiers, waiters... each with a personal PIN.
users.noStaff: No employee yet: you can add some later.
users.technicianHint: A separate secret for the technician menu. Keep it somewhere safe.
users.techCodeHint: 6 characters at least, different from every PIN
users.techMismatch: The two technician codes are not identical.
users.techNote: This code is never shown again.

backups.title: Backups
backups.lead: Protect the till's data: test each destination.

rolesHint.disk: A second disk of this computer.
rolesHint.usb: A copy as soon as the key is plugged in.
rolesHint.nas: A shared folder (NAS) or a network drive.

backups.noneHint: With no destination, backups stay on this disk only. Add at least one external destination.
backups.checklistHint: To check on the computer: this list is only a reminder.

check.bios: BIOS: restart automatically after a power cut
check.autologin: System: automatic sign-in for the till user

finish.title: Installing
finish.lead: Wait a few seconds, do not close the application.
finish.doneLead: The till is ready. Employees sign in with their PIN.
finish.failedLead: Nothing was lost: fix it and try again.
finish.warnings: The installation is finished, with points to check:

warn.backup_failed: The first backup failed. Check the destinations in the technician menu.
warn.autostart_failed: Automatic start could not be turned on. Turn it on in the system.
warn.backup_target: A backup destination does not respond ({{detail}}).

fieldErrors.legal_notConfirmed: Check the company details, then press Next to confirm them.
fieldErrors.vatRates: The VAT rates must cover every product of the catalogue.
fieldErrors.importFile: Choose a catalogue file without errors.
fieldErrors.users: A manager with a username and password is needed.
fieldErrors.users_username: Username missing, invalid or already used.
fieldErrors.users_username_together: The username and password go together.
fieldErrors.users_password: The password has 8 characters at least.
fieldErrors.users_password_together: The username and password go together.
fieldErrors.technicianCode: The technician code has 6 characters at least.
fieldErrors.technicianCode_techPin: The technician code must differ from every PIN.
fieldErrors.routing: This routing points to an unknown printer or category.
fieldErrors.backups_path_twice: This destination is already in the list.
